corrections.from: St. Lucie County schools close Wednesday as superintendent pledges flood review
corrections.to: St. Lucie schools superintendent pledges review after bus flooding incident

corrections.from: St. Lucie County Schools canceled Wednesday classes with heavy rain in the forecast, and Superintendent Dr. Jon Prince promised to review the district’s decisions during the Nov. 2 flooding. The review follows criticism over a video showing a boy wading through chest-high water after getting off a school bus in Port St. Lucie.
corrections.to: St. Lucie Public Schools Superintendent Dr. Jon Prince said the district will review its policies and decisions during the Nov. 2 flooding after video showed a student wading through chest-high water after getting off a school bus in Port St. Lucie. Prince said officials are examining whether the district could have responded differently.

corrections.from: Prince said the district will monitor the weather Wednesday and decide late Wednesday afternoon whether to cancel Thursday classes. He said the district will continue that approach until officials are sure students can safely return. Prince said he hopes Wednesday’s closure is an overreaction but does not want to take chances.
corrections.to: The review pledge comes as district schools and offices remain closed Wednesday, Nov. 18, amid another flood threat. Prince said officials would monitor conditions and decide late Wednesday afternoon whether to cancel Thursday classes. He said he hoped the precaution would prove unnecessary but did not want to risk another dangerous situation.
